# gravity_tftp_file (Resource)

File served by the TFTP role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Text file, served to every client

resource "gravity_tftp_file" "boot_script" {
  host    = "*"
  name    = "boot.ipxe"
  content = <<-EOT
    #!ipxe
    chain http://boot.my-domain.com/menu.ipxe
  EOT
}

# Binary file, served only to clients connecting to a specific address

resource "gravity_tftp_file" "undionly" {
  host           = "10.10.0.1"
  name           = "undionly.kpxe"
  content_base64 = filebase64("${path.module}/undionly.kpxe")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Host the file is served for. Use `*` to serve it to every client regardless of the address they connect to.
- `name` (String) Path the file is served under.

### Optional

- `content` (String) File contents as text. Use `content_base64` for binary files.
- `content_base64` (String) File contents, base64-encoded.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Size of the stored file. Generated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Files are identified by the host they are served for and their name
terraform import gravity_tftp_file.boot_script '*/boot.ipxe'
```
